model_context: Saccharomyces cerevisiae R2TP and chromatin-remodeling complex assembly experiments; yeast Ino80 is mapped to human INO80 only for contextual annotation.
evidence_limitations: The mechanistic result is centered on Rvb1/2 and R2TP; INO80 is a downstream complex context and not a demonstrated Hsp90 partner in this source.
claim_summary: The source links Hsp90-R2TP handling of Rvb1/2 to assembly of the yeast Ino80 complex, but it does not demonstrate a direct Hsp90-Ino80 pair or establish Ino80 as an Hsp90 client.

source.title: Navigating the Chaperone Network: An Integrative Map of Physical and Genetic Interactions Mediated by the Hsp90 Chaperone

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Saccharomyces cerevisiae genome-wide interaction screens, TAP purification, growth assays, and R2TP/INO80/SWR-C assembly context; Rvb1 is mapped conservatively to human RUVBL1.
evidence_limitations: The primary work is yeast-only and supports a transient network/assembly relationship rather than a pairwise human HSP90-RUVBL1 client mechanism.
claim_summary: In yeast, Rvb1 copurifies with Tah1-Pih1 in the R2TP complex, Hsp90 is recovered with TAP-tagged Rvb1 in the interaction screen, and the source proposes a transient Hsp90-R2TP folding or assembly role for Rvb1/2 before entry into larger chromatin-remodeling complexes.

source.title: Navigating the Chaperone Network: An Integrative Map of Physical and Genetic Interactions Mediated by the Hsp90 Chaperone

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Saccharomyces cerevisiae genome-wide interaction screens, TAP purification, growth assays, and R2TP/INO80/SWR-C assembly context; Rvb2 is mapped conservatively to human RUVBL2.
evidence_limitations: The primary work is yeast-only and supports a transient network/assembly relationship rather than a pairwise human HSP90-RUVBL2 client mechanism.
claim_summary: In yeast, Rvb2 copurifies with Tah1-Pih1 in R2TP; genetic and complex-purification results support a functional Hsp90-R2TP relationship and a proposed folding or assembly role for Rvb1/2 before incorporation into INO80 or SWR-C complexes.

source.title: Characterization of the AhR-hsp90-XAP2 Core Complex and the Role of the Immunophilin-Related Protein XAP2 in AhR Stabilization

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Rabbit-reticulocyte and GST-Hsp90 fragment binding assays, COS-1 transfection and immunoadsorption, and ligand-treated Hepa 1 nuclear extracts defining the unliganded AHR-Hsp90-XAP2 complex and activated AHR-ARNT transition.
evidence_limitations: The source establishes AHR binding to an Hsp90 middle-domain fragment and core-complex architecture but does not resolve HSP90AA1 versus HSP90AB1 or establish AHR client dependence by Hsp90-selective perturbation.
claim_summary: Domain-mapping experiments showed that AHR and XAP2 occupy distinct regions of Hsp90: radiolabeled AHR bound a middle-domain GST-Hsp90 fragment, whereas XAP2 bound the Hsp90 C terminus; AHR also bound XAP2 without Hsp90, and the unliganded cytosolic complex dissociated upon AHR-ARNT activation.

source.title: Characterization of the AhR-hsp90-XAP2 Core Complex and the Role of the Immunophilin-Related Protein XAP2 in AhR Stabilization

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: GST-Hsp90 fragment and rabbit-reticulocyte binding assays plus COS-1 and Hepa 1 cellular complex, domain-deletion, AHR abundance, and ligand-activation experiments.
evidence_limitations: The study resolves direct XAP2/AIP-Hsp90 domain binding and AHR stabilization but not HSP90AA1 versus HSP90AB1 specificity; AIP is a cochaperone-like complex component, not an Hsp90 client.
claim_summary: XAP2/AIP bound the C-terminal region of Hsp90 through XAP2 C-terminal sequences, co-immunoprecipitated with cellular Hsp90 complexes, bound AHR independently of Hsp90, and increased steady-state cytosolic AHR abundance in COS-1 cells, supporting a TPR cochaperone-like stabilizing role in the unliganded core complex.

source.title: Direct Activation of HSP90A Transcription by c-Myc Contributes to c-Myc-induced Transformation

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AA1/Hsp90alpha; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Human lymphoblastoid, HeLa, 293T, U937, and fibroblast cell systems plus mouse/rat fibroblast and MycER models, using expression, knockdown, inducible-MYC, promoter, ChIP, soft-agar, and tumorigenicity assays.
evidence_limitations: The source establishes MYC upstream regulation of HSP90A/HSP90AA1, not an Hsp90-MYC protein interaction, MYC client dependence, or a comparison against HSP90AB1.
claim_summary: c-Myc increased HSP90A/Hsp86alpha RNA and protein across multiple cell models, endogenous MYC knockdown reduced HSP90A, MycER induction was rapid and protein-synthesis independent, and promoter-reporter plus chromatin-immunoprecipitation assays showed direct c-Myc binding and activation at an HSP90A promoter E-box; HSP90A expression also contributed to transformation phenotypes.

source.title: Association of the Ah receptor with the 90-kDa heat shock protein

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Murine Hepa 1c1c7 cytosol with human HeLa and rat liver cytosolic follow-up, using AHR photoaffinity labeling, AHR-directed immunoprecipitation, Hsp90 immunoblotting, heparin dissociation, and sucrose-gradient analysis.
evidence_limitations: The study establishes AHR-Hsp90 complex association but does not resolve HSP90AA1 versus HSP90AB1, demonstrate purified pairwise binding, or test AHR stability or functional dependence on Hsp90.
claim_summary: An AHR-directed monoclonal antibody co-immunoprecipitated photoaffinity-labeled AHR together with a 90-kDa protein identified as Hsp90 by immunoblotting; heparin dissociated the complex, and analogous AHR-Hsp90 co-immunoprecipitation was observed in murine Hepa 1, human HeLa, and rat liver cytosol.

source.title: OSBP-related protein-2 (ORP2): a novel Akt effector that controls cellular energy metabolism

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: HuH7 ORP2-knockout and GST-ORP2 pull-down assays, with HUVEC knockdown validation and AKT phosphorylation/function readouts.
evidence_limitations: The cell-lysate pull-down supports complex membership but not purified direct ORP2-Hsp90 binding, HSP90AA1 versus HSP90AB1 specificity, or canonical client dependence.
claim_summary: GST-ORP2 pull-downs from HuH7 lysates contained endogenous CDC37, Hsp90, and active AKT, and ORP2 depletion reduced AKT signaling, supporting ORP2 membership in an Hsp90-CDC37-AKT regulatory complex.

source.title: Temperature-sensitive ZAP70 mutants degrading through a proteasome-independent pathway. Restoration of a kinase domain mutant by Cdc37.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Temperature-sensitive ZAP70 mutants expressed in mammalian cells, with CDC37 association/rescue and Hsp90-inhibitor tests.
evidence_limitations: The chaperone-dependence conclusion is specific to the M572L mutant and does not establish wild-type ZAP70 as a general Hsp90 client or resolve HSP90AA1 versus HSP90AB1.
claim_summary: The temperature-sensitive ZAP70 M572L kinase-domain mutant associated with CDC37 and was functionally rescued by CDC37, but the rescue was lost when Hsp90 was inhibited; the P80Q mutant followed a different route.

source.title: Requirement for a kinase-specific chaperone pathway in the production of a Cdk9/cyclin T1 heterodimer responsible for P-TEFb-mediated tat stimulation of HIV-1 transcription.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human-cell recombinant and endogenous CDK9/cyclin T1 complexes assayed by affinity purification, immunoprecipitation, chaperone perturbation, and Tat-dependent transcription readouts.
evidence_limitations: The study resolves a chaperone pathway and co-complex but not purified pairwise CDK9-Hsp90 binding or cytosolic isoform preference.
claim_summary: Affinity-purified and endogenous CDK9 complexes contained Hsp90, Hsp70, CDC37, and cyclin T1, and inhibitor and assembly experiments supported a sequential kinase-specific chaperone pathway required for active P-TEFb production.

source.title: Effects of geldanamycin, a heat-shock protein 90-binding agent, on T cell function and T cell nonreceptor protein tyrosine kinases.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: T-cell and heterologous expression systems with geldanamycin exposure, pulse-chase analysis, kinase abundance, and T-cell functional readouts.
evidence_limitations: The source is pharmacology-led and does not provide purified pairwise binding or cytosolic isoform resolution; dependence is strongest for newly synthesized LCK.
claim_summary: Hsp90 inhibition rapidly depleted newly synthesized LCK, affected mature LCK more slowly, and impaired LCK-linked T-cell signaling and function, supporting maturation-stage chaperone dependence.

source.title: CYP2E1 degradation by in vitro reconstituted systems: role of the molecular chaperone hsp90.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Rabbit liver microsomes and cytosolic fractions in an in vitro reconstituted degradation system with Hsp90 immunodepletion and purified-protein add-back.
evidence_limitations: The result is reconstituted and Hsp90 promotes turnover rather than protecting a canonical folding client; a later intact-cell study did not reproduce inhibitor-sensitive CYP2E1 turnover.
claim_summary: In a reconstituted microsome-cytosol system, Hsp90 immunodepletion suppressed CYP2E1 degradation and purified Hsp90 restored it, while pharmacologic and biochemical controls supported an Hsp90-dependent quality-control route.

source.title: Identifying genes regulated in a Myc-dependent manner.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AB1/Hsp90beta; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: MYC-dependent cell systems analyzed by microarray and RNA-expression follow-up.
evidence_limitations: The paper supports MYC-dependent HSP90AB1 expression but not an Hsp90-MYC protein interaction, client relationship, or direct promoter occupancy at HSP90AB1.
claim_summary: Expression profiling and follow-up RNA analyses identified HSP90 beta among genes regulated in a MYC-dependent manner, supporting MYC as an upstream regulator of HSP90AB1 expression rather than as an Hsp90 client.

source.title: Selective apoptosis of tandemly duplicated FLT3-transformed leukemia cells by Hsp90 inhibitors.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Leukemia and transformed cell models comparing tandem-duplicated FLT3 with wild-type FLT3 under geldanamycin-family and radicicol treatment.
evidence_limitations: The client call is mutation-specific and cannot be generalized to wild-type FLT3 or an individual cytosolic Hsp90 isoform.
claim_summary: Tandem-duplicated FLT3, but not wild-type FLT3, associated with Hsp90; Hsp90 inhibitors disrupted the complex, depleted the mutant receptor and its signaling, and selectively induced apoptosis in transformed leukemia cells.

source.title: Interactions of STAT3 with caveolin-1 and heat shock protein 90 in plasma membrane raft and cytosolic complexes. Preservation of cytokine signaling during fever.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Cellular membrane-raft and cytosolic fractionation under cytokine stimulation and fever-range temperature stress.
evidence_limitations: The source establishes complex membership and functional chaperone context but not purified STAT3-Hsp90 binding, canonical folding-client dependence, or cytosolic isoform specificity.
claim_summary: STAT3 co-occurred with Hsp90, caveolin-1, and GRP58 in high-molecular-mass membrane-raft and cytosolic complexes, and Hsp90 perturbation impaired temperature-stressed cytokine signaling.

source.title: Definition of protein kinase sequence motifs that trigger high affinity binding of Hsp90 and Cdc37.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Full-length LCK and engineered kinase-domain constructs used for chaperone co-adsorption, salt stability, and sequence-motif mapping.
evidence_limitations: The high-affinity recognition is mapped with constructs in an Hsp90-CDC37 context; the source does not isolate purified pairwise LCK-Hsp90 binding or cytosolic isoform preference.
claim_summary: Full-length LCK and mapped kinase-domain constructs formed salt-stable Hsp90-CDC37 complexes, and sequence substitutions localized kinase features that control high-affinity chaperone recognition.

source.title: Hsp90 inhibitors deplete key anti-apoptotic proteins in pediatric solid tumor cells and demonstrate synergistic anticancer activity with cisplatin.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Pediatric solid-tumor cell lines treated with Hsp90 inhibitors alone and with cisplatin.
evidence_limitations: IGF1R depletion is inhibitor-based and the paper does not show an IGF1R-Hsp90 complex, purified binding, or individual cytosolic-isoform dependence.
claim_summary: Geldanamycin-family Hsp90 inhibition depleted IGF1R across pediatric solid-tumor cell lines and was accompanied by loss of survival signaling and enhanced cisplatin response.

source.title: Roles of 3-phosphoinositide-dependent kinase 1 in the regulation of endothelial nitric-oxide synthase phosphorylation and function by heat shock protein 90.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Endothelial-cell signaling assays combining Hsp90 inhibition, proteasome rescue, PDPK1 knockdown, and PDPK1 overexpression rescue.
evidence_limitations: The source strongly links Hsp90 activity to PDPK1 stability and function but does not demonstrate an Hsp90-PDPK1 complex or cytosolic isoform preference.
claim_summary: Two Hsp90 inhibitors depleted PDPK1, proteasome inhibition rescued its abundance, PDPK1 knockdown phenocopied the signaling defect, and PDPK1 overexpression rescued downstream eNOS and AKT responses.

source.title: Evidence for chaperone heterocomplexes containing both Hsp90 and VCP.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Native mammalian-cell chaperone complexes analyzed by immunoprecipitation, affinity capture, salt challenge, and geldanamycin/molybdate perturbation.
evidence_limitations: The study supports native complex membership but not purified direct VCP-Hsp90 binding, client dependence, or cytosolic isoform specificity.
claim_summary: VCP co-occurred with Hsp90, CDC37, FKBP52, and p23 in native chaperone heterocomplexes; salt and inhibitor tests distinguished the VCP-containing complex from a canonical unstable client complex.

source.title: Differential effects of Hsp90 inhibition on protein kinases regulating signal transduction pathways required for myoblast differentiation.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Myoblast differentiation models with Hsp90 inhibition, kinase co-complex analysis, and newly synthesized versus mature FYN stability assays.
evidence_limitations: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90 isoforms or purified pairwise binding; dependence is strongest during FYN maturation.
claim_summary: Newly synthesized FYN associated with Hsp90 and CDC37 and was rapidly destabilized by Hsp90 inhibition, whereas mature FYN was less sensitive, supporting maturation-stage client dependence.

source.title: Folding and quality control of the VHL tumor suppressor proceed through distinct chaperone pathways.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Yeast Hsp82/STI1 genetics and mammalian VHL folding/quality-control assays using misfolded and temperature-sensitive variants plus Hsp90 inhibition.
evidence_limitations: The conclusion concerns misfolded-VHL quality control, not productive wild-type folding or an individual cytosolic Hsp90 isoform; cited supplemental figures were not in the retrieved package.
claim_summary: Genetic and pharmacologic experiments separated VHL folding from quality control: Hsp90, linked through HOP/STI1, promoted degradation of misfolded VHL rather than productive folding, and inhibition stabilized the misfolded species.

source.title: Pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic relationships for the heat shock protein 90 molecular chaperone inhibitor 17-allylamino, 17-demethoxygeldanamycin in human ovarian cancer xenograft models.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human A2780 and CH1 ovarian cancer cells, corresponding nude-mouse xenografts and murine peripheral blood leukocytes, plus ex vivo human peripheral blood leukocytes.
evidence_limitations: The study validates CDK4 depletion as an Hsp90-inhibition pharmacodynamic marker but does not assay purified binding, an Hsp90-CDK4 complex, or individual cytosolic isoforms; CDK4 client status is partly grounded in prior literature cited by the authors.
claim_summary: 17-AAG caused concentration-dependent CDK4 depletion at pharmacologically relevant concentrations in A2780 and CH1 ovarian cancer cells, depleted CDK4 in A2780 xenografts and murine peripheral blood leukocytes during treatment, and produced a marker signature not reproduced by paclitaxel or carboplatin in human leukocytes.

source.title: Distinct roles of unliganded and liganded estrogen receptors in transcriptional repression.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Primary human osteoblasts, inducible or tagged ER U2OS osteosarcoma cells, and MCF-7 breast cancer cells under TNF and estradiol perturbation.
evidence_limitations: The source supports membership of c-JUN and Hsp90 in the same promoter-associated activation assembly, but does not show direct JUN-Hsp90 binding, shared re-ChIP, Hsp90-dependent JUN stability, or cytosolic isoform specificity.
claim_summary: TNF recruited c-JUN, NF-kappaB factors, unliganded ER, CBP, and Hsp90 to the TNFA promoter; the authors interpret these ChIP results as an activation complex, while re-ChIP directly demonstrated ER-Hsp90 and ER-CBP co-occupancy rather than a JUN-Hsp90 pair.

source.title: Hsp90 increases LIM kinase activity by promoting its homo-dimerization.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Endogenous MDA-MB-231 breast cancer-cell complexes and 293T cells expressing full-length, kinase-domain, kinase-dead, or P394E LIMK1 constructs, with endogenous Hsp90 co-IP and Hsp90 inhibitor/siRNA perturbation.
evidence_limitations: The mechanism combines endogenous association with overexpression, inhibitor, crosslinking, and mutant assays, but does not resolve HSP90AA1 versus HSP90AB1 or isolate purified pairwise binding.
claim_summary: Endogenous LIMK1 reciprocally co-immunoprecipitated with endogenous Hsp90; Hsp90 inhibition or knockdown reduced LIMK1 abundance and dimerization, while kinase-domain mapping and the P394E mutant reduced Hsp90 association, dimerization, transphosphorylation, activity, and half-life.

source.title: STAT3 and MAPK signaling maintain overexpression of heat shock proteins 90alpha and beta in multiple myeloma cells, which critically contribute to tumor-cell survival.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human INA-6 and ANBL-6 IL-6-dependent multiple-myeloma cells under 17-DMAG exposure, including bone-marrow stromal, osteoclast, and endothelial-cell coculture contexts.
evidence_limitations: Loss of phosphorylated STAT3 can reflect depletion of upstream JAK-family kinases, and total STAT3 fell only partially; no Hsp90-STAT3 co-IP or isoform-selective STAT3 handling was tested in this paper.
claim_summary: Broad Hsp90 inhibition with 17-DMAG strongly suppressed STAT3 Y705 phosphorylation and partially reduced total STAT3 in INA-6 and ANBL-6 cells while reducing myeloma-cell viability; the study proposes a reciprocal Hsp90-STAT3/MAPK survival loop.

source.title: STAT3 and MAPK signaling maintain overexpression of heat shock proteins 90alpha and beta in multiple myeloma cells, which critically contribute to tumor-cell survival.

isoform_scope_note: Both cytosolic HSP90 isoforms were measured in the reported experiment; measurement alone does not establish isoform exclusivity.
model_context: Human INA-6 and ANBL-6 IL-6-dependent multiple-myeloma cells cultured with or without primary bone-marrow stromal cells; Affymetrix expression profiling and isoform-specific immunoblotting.
evidence_limitations: Because STAT3 and MAPK were blocked together for the decisive expression result, this paper does not isolate STAT3's contribution or show direct STAT3 occupancy at either HSP90 promoter; it supports pathway-level upstream regulation rather than an Hsp90-STAT3 protein interaction.
claim_summary: Combined IL-6R/STAT3 and MEK/ERK blockade reduced HSP90AA1 and HSP90AB1 transcripts and proteins in multiple-myeloma cells, while bone-marrow stromal-cell signaling increased both proteins, supporting STAT3/MAPK-dependent upstream maintenance of both cytosolic Hsp90 isoforms.

source.title: Proteomics discovery of metalloproteinase substrates in the cellular context by iTRAQ labeling reveals a diverse MMP-2 substrate degradome.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AA1/Hsp90alpha; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Mmp2-null mouse embryonic fibroblasts expressing active or catalytic-dead human MMP2 for conditioned-medium iTRAQ, followed by purified human MMP2 cleavage of recombinant human HSP90alpha.
evidence_limitations: The direct cleavage assay is in vitro and the cell-based discovery is extracellular/conditioned-medium proteomics; physiological cleavage consequences and exact cleavage site were not established, and purified HSP90beta cleavage was not tested. The result does not mean that MMP2 is an Hsp90 client. This 2007 paper also cannot by chronology resolve the separate 2006 review-citation backtrace.
claim_summary: Cell-based iTRAQ degradomics identified extracellular HSP90alpha, but not HSP90beta, as selectively altered with active MMP2, and purified active MMP2 directly cleaved HSP90alpha into approximately 80-kDa and 50-kDa fragments before clearance.

source.title: FK506-binding protein 52 phosphorylation: a potential mechanism for regulating steroid hormone receptor activity.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Radiolabeled human FKBP52 variants in rabbit reticulocyte lysate Hsp90/p23 and progesterone-receptor complex assays, plus yeast steroid-receptor reporters and wild-type or Fkbp4-null mouse embryonic fibroblasts.
evidence_limitations: The binding assays use broad Hsp90 and do not resolve HSP90AA1 versus HSP90AB1; the T143E mutant models phosphorylation but actual T143 phosphorylation was difficult to quantify in endogenous cells, and the study addresses cochaperone regulation rather than FKBP4 client dependence.
claim_summary: FKBP52 bound broad Hsp90 and p23-containing Hsp90 complexes and assembled into progesterone-receptor/Hsp90 complexes; FK-linker and T143 mutants preserved Hsp90/complex association, whereas the T143E phosphomimetic selectively lost steroid-receptor potentiation, separating cochaperone binding from regulatory function.

source.title: Effect of the histone deacetylase inhibitor LBH589 against epidermal growth factor receptor-dependent human lung cancer cells.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: EGFR-mutant and wild-type non-small-cell lung cancer lines, especially HCC827, treated with LBH589, 17DMAG, proteasome inhibitor PS341, and erlotinib.
evidence_limitations: LBH589 has transcriptional and non-Hsp90 effects and the co-IP does not establish purified pairwise binding or cytosolic isoform preference; nevertheless, proteasome rescue and 17DMAG corroboration strengthen the chaperone-dependence interpretation. The PDF carries a 2019 editor's note stating that a figure-content inquiry was reviewed and no action was taken at that time.
claim_summary: STAT3 co-immunoprecipitated with broad Hsp90 in HCC827 cells; LBH589-induced Hsp90 acetylation disrupted the complex, proteasome blockade prevented STAT3 depletion, and both LBH589 and the direct Hsp90 inhibitor 17DMAG reduced STAT3 signaling and abundance in EGFR-mutant lung-cancer cells.

source.title: Enhanced methyltransferase activity of SMYD3 by the cleavage of its N-terminal region in human cancer cells.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AA1/Hsp90alpha; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Human cancer tissues and cell lines plus recombinant or epitope-tagged SMYD3 constructs in HEK293-derived cells and bacterial protein preparations.
evidence_limitations: The main article explicitly reports HSP90alpha association, but the decisive coimmunoprecipitation panels are only in unavailable Supplementary Figure 2; HSP90AB1 was not tested, and the effect of HSP90alpha on SMYD3 activity in this paper is interpreted alongside an earlier study.
claim_summary: Wild-type SMYD3 associated with HSP90alpha, whereas N-terminally cleaved or G15A/G17A mutant SMYD3 lost that association; the same variants showed elevated methyltransferase activity, supporting an N-terminal HSP90AA1-associated regulatory state.

source.title: Regulation of 3-phosphoinositide-dependent protein kinase-1 (PDK1) by Src involves tyrosine phosphorylation of PDK1 and Src homology 2 domain binding.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: HEK293 cells expressing wild-type or tyrosine-mutant PDPK1, endogenous complex assays, Hsp90 overexpression or combined alpha/beta knockdown, Hsp90 inhibitors, and Src-dependent kinase readouts.
evidence_limitations: The source does not resolve HSP90AA1 versus HSP90AB1, and several complex and activity experiments use overexpression or pervanadate stimulation rather than an unperturbed endogenous state.
claim_summary: PDK1 coimmunoprecipitated with Hsp90, Hsp90 inhibition disrupted the complex and destabilized PDK1 through a partly proteasome-dependent route, Hsp90 overexpression enhanced PDK1-Src assembly and PDK1 activity, and Hsp90 knockdown reduced PDK1 activity and Src binding.

source.title: Heat shock protein 90beta: a novel mediator of vitamin D action.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AB1/Hsp90beta; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Human Caco-2 intestinal epithelial cells with stable HSP90B1 shRNA, a scrambled control, geldanamycin treatment, VDR DNA-binding assays, and vitamin D-responsive transcriptional readouts.
evidence_limitations: The study establishes HSP90B1-specific functional dependence but does not demonstrate VDR-HSP90B1 physical association, ligand-loading, or a classical folding-client mechanism; the unchanged nuclear VDR level argues against a simple stability effect.
claim_summary: HSP90B1-specific knockdown, which spared HSP90AA1, markedly reduced vitamin D-induced CYP24 expression and VDR-dependent reporter activity without reducing nuclear VDR or RXRA abundance; geldanamycin independently reduced VDR DNA binding and transcriptional responses.

source.title: Gamendazole, an orally active indazole carboxylic acid male contraceptive agent, targets HSP90AB1 (HSP90BETA) and EEF1A1 (eEF1A), and stimulates Il1a transcription in rat Sertoli cells.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Rat testis, rat TM4 Sertoli cells, mouse ID8 ovarian cells, purified yeast Hsp82, rabbit reticulocyte lysate, and human MCF-7 breast cancer cells treated with gamendazole.
evidence_limitations: The source directly validates the compound-Hsp90 route but assays AKT1 only as a downstream abundance readout; it neither tests an AKT1-HSP90 complex nor excludes contributions from the EEF1A1 cotarget, and HSP90AB1 compound capture does not establish beta-exclusive AKT1 chaperoning.
claim_summary: Gamendazole affinity-purified HSP90AB1 from mammalian lysates, bound purified yeast Hsp82, inhibited Hsp90-dependent luciferase refolding, and caused dose-dependent AKT1 and ERBB2 depletion in MCF-7 cells, supporting pharmacologic Hsp90-client destabilization of AKT1.

source.title: Heat shock protein 90 inhibition is cytotoxic to primary AML cells expressing mutant FLT3 and results in altered downstream signalling.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Primary human AML blasts stratified by FLT3-ITD, FLT3-D835, or wild-type status, with supporting FLT3-transfected 32D myeloid models and 17-AAG perturbation.
evidence_limitations: The direct coimmunoprecipitation subset required high-blast-count specimens and may not represent all AML; the relationship is mutant-specific and does not establish wild-type FLT3 as an Hsp90 client.
claim_summary: Mutant FLT3, but not wild-type FLT3, coimmunoprecipitated with Hsp90 in primary AML blasts; 17-AAG disrupted the mutant FLT3-Hsp90 complex, reduced mutant FLT3 abundance and phosphorylation, altered downstream STAT5, ERK, and AKT signaling, and preferentially reduced viability of FLT3-mutant blasts.

source.title: Mitotic catastrophe cell death induced by heat shock protein 90 inhibitor in BRCA1-deficient breast cancer cell lines.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Panel of human BRCA1-wild-type and BRCA1-null breast cancer cell lines treated with 17-AAG, plus BRCA1 or CHEK1 siRNA in MCF-7 cells and cell-cycle or mitotic-entry readouts.
evidence_limitations: The paper directly assays CHEK1 depletion and functional checkpoint contribution but does not assay an Hsp90-CHEK1 complex, proteasome dependence, or cytosolic isoform specificity; 17-AAG affects many cell-cycle clients.
claim_summary: 17-AAG caused time-dependent CHEK1 depletion, especially in BRCA1-null breast cancer cells, while CHEK2 was unchanged; CHEK1 knockdown in BRCA1-positive MCF-7 cells weakened the 17-AAG-induced G2-M checkpoint and increased mitotic entry, linking CHEK1 loss to the treatment phenotype.

source.title: New molecular and biological mechanism of antitumor activities of KW-2478, a novel nonansamycin heat shock protein 90 inhibitor, in multiple myeloma cells.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human multiple-myeloma cell lines with varied IgH translocations and NCI-H929 SCID-mouse xenografts treated with the Hsp90 inhibitor KW-2478.
evidence_limitations: The source shows robust cell and tumor CDK9 depletion but does not directly assay a CDK9-Hsp90 complex or genetic Hsp90 dependence; the HSP90AA1 compound-binding assay cannot resolve CDK9 client isoform scope.
claim_summary: KW-2478 caused time-dependent CDK9 depletion before c-MAF and cyclin D1 loss in myeloma cells and reduced CDK9 in NCI-H929 xenografts while inducing the Hsp90-inhibition marker Hsp70; complementary transcriptional and flavopiridol experiments linked CDK9 loss to downstream gene suppression.

source.title: New molecular and biological mechanism of antitumor activities of KW-2478, a novel nonansamycin heat shock protein 90 inhibitor, in multiple myeloma cells.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human OPM-2/GFP and NCI-H929 multiple-myeloma cells expressing mutant or wild-type FGFR3, with biochemical HSP90AA1 compound binding and KW-2478 perturbation.
evidence_limitations: The direct FGFR3-Hsp90 coimmunoprecipitation and proteasome-rescue panels are confined to missing Supplementary Figures S2-S3; binding of KW-2478 to HSP90AA1 does not establish that FGFR3 is exclusively an HSP90AA1 client.
claim_summary: KW-2478 bound purified human HSP90AA1 and caused rapid, dose- and time-dependent FGFR3 depletion in FGFR3-expressing myeloma cells; the authors report proteasome rescue and FGFR3-Hsp90 coimmunoprecipitation in Supplementary Figures S2-S3, supporting FGFR3 as an Hsp90-stabilized client.

source.title: RET is a heat shock protein 90 (HSP90) client protein and is knocked down upon HSP90 pharmacological block.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: RAT1 fibroblasts expressing wild-type or MEN2-mutant RET, HEK293 CHIP and ubiquitin assays, and human TT or MZCRC1 medullary-thyroid-carcinoma models described in the absent supplement.

source.title: Synergistic role of HSP90alpha and HSP90beta to promote myofibroblast persistence in lung fibrosis.

claim_summary: Extracellular HSP90alpha crosslinker-dependently co-immunoprecipitated with LRP1 in primary IPF fibroblasts, HSP90alpha-LRP1 colocalization increased in IPF fibroblasts and patient lung tissue, and the extracellular HSP90 inhibitor HS-30 disrupted the association. LRP1 knockdown abolished recombinant HSP90alpha-induced ERK and Smad2 phosphorylation, alpha-SMA expression, and collagen 1A expression.

source.title: Synergistic role of HSP90alpha and HSP90beta to promote myofibroblast persistence in lung fibrosis.

claim_summary: Intracellular HSP90beta strongly co-immunoprecipitated with LRP1 in primary IPF fibroblasts. Isoform-specific HSP90beta knockdown reduced LRP1 abundance, and MG132 restored LRP1, whereas HSP90alpha knockdown did not reduce LRP1, supporting HSP90beta-dependent protection of LRP1 from proteasomal degradation.

source.title: Stress-induced phosphoprotein 1 mediates hepatocellular carcinoma metastasis after insufficient radiofrequency ablation.

The co-IP establishes complex association rather than purified pairwise binding, and novobiocin cannot by itself establish a specific transport mechanism. claim_summary: Sublethal heat induced nuclear accumulation and colocalization of STIP1 with HSP90, and reciprocal nuclear co-immunoprecipitation detected a heat-induced STIP1-HSP90 complex associated with Snail1 accumulation. Novobiocin disrupted the complex and reduced STIP1 nuclear translocation, mesenchymal-promoter activation, and invasion, while STIP1 knockdown reduced heat-induced mesenchymal expression, migration, and metastasis.

source.title: Erbin interacts with NHERF1 and Ezrin to stabilize a membrane ErbB2 signaling complex in HER2-positive breast cancer

claim_summary: ERBIN knockdown reduced HER2 abundance and phosphorylation, membrane protrusions, and the HSP90-HER2 coimmunoprecipitation signal. Proximity ligation directly detected ERBIN-HSP90 near-proximity and ERBIN-dependent HER2-HSP90, NHERF1-HSP90, and ezrin-HSP90 proximity in a membrane-associated complex. These data support ERBIN as an HSP90-proximal binding partner and organizer of an HSP90-containing HER2 signaling complex, not as an established HSP90 client.

source.title: Linking Aβ and tau in the amyloid cascade through the intersection of their proteostasis networks

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.

HSP90AB1 appears in network/database context, but the primary experiments do not resolve alpha versus beta or test SUGT1 action within a defined chaperone cycle.
claim_summary: Aftin-5 increased SUGT1 and HSP90 signal and their cellular colocalization. SUGT1 knockdown reduced Aftin-5-induced phospho-tau and GSK3B, while SUGT1 overexpression increased intracellular amyloid-beta 42; HSP90 inhibition with geldanamycin produced parallel reductions in phospho-tau/GSK3B and intracellular amyloid-beta 42. The source supports a functional SUGT1 cochaperone/pathway role in this model but does not demonstrate purified SUGT1-HSP90 binding or SUGT1 as an HSP90 client.

source.title: Transient Hsp90 suppression promotes a heritable change in protein translation

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AB1/Hsp90beta; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Human-cell interaction screening and confirmation using full-length and prion-domain-deletion CPEB2 constructs, followed by a Saccharomyces cerevisiae CPEB2 prion-domain reporter model for functional assays.
evidence_limitations: The human LUMIER assay resolves HSP90 beta, but endogenous coimmunoprecipitation and the yeast functional experiments do not. Complex capture is not purified pairwise binding, and the functional evidence uses a heterologous prion-domain fusion plus pharmacologic Hsp90 inhibition rather than native human CPEB2 folding or stability.
claim_summary: A human HSP90 beta-Renilla luciferase LUMIER screen identified CPEB2, and immunoprecipitation/immunoblotting plus affinity-purification mass spectrometry confirmed association with endogenous HSP90/chaperone machinery. Deleting the CPEB2 prion-like domain removed HSP90 binding. In a heterologous yeast reporter system, Hsp90 inhibition enhanced CPEB2 prion-domain-dependent reporter activation and translation-memory phenotypes. This establishes CPEB2 as an HSP90AB1-resolved binding partner while leaving client status unproven.

source.title: Activation of Chaperon-Mediated Autophagy Via Modulation of Hsp90 Activity Inhibits Tumor Growth Under Hypoxia

The TCGA HSP90AA1-TFEB correlations are context only and do not establish isoform-specific mechanism.
claim_summary: Manassantin A inhibited HSP90-dependent luciferase refolding, disrupted the HSP90-ATP synthase beta complex, reduced phospho-AKT, and promoted TFEB nuclear localization alongside chaperone-mediated autophagy. TFEB knockdown tested TFEB necessity for downstream HIF1A/CMA responses, and 17-AAG produced a parallel CMA-reporter phenotype. The paper supports TFEB as a downstream HSP90-inhibition-responsive localization/autophagy regulator, not as an HSP90 client or binding partner.

source.title: Activation of Chaperon-Mediated Autophagy Via Modulation of Hsp90 Activity Inhibits Tumor Growth Under Hypoxia

source.title: A cytosolic heat shock protein 90 and co-chaperone p23 complex activates RIPK3/MLKL during necroptosis of endothelial cells in acute respiratory distress syndrome.
