source.title: Phosphorylation-dependent interaction of the asialoglycoprotein receptor with molecular chaperones.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human HuH-7 hepatoma cells and the derived Trf1 trafficking mutant; recombinant human ASGR2/H2b cytoplasmic domain phosphorylated by CK2; native ASGPR immunoadsorption from CHAPS lysates.
evidence_limitations: The decisive affinity bait is ASGR2/H2b, not ASGR1/H1. Hsp90 is generic, complex membership is not direct binding, and rapamycin can act through FKBP-TOR as well as Hsp-immunophilin complex disruption.
claim_summary: A CK2-phosphorylated GST fusion of the human ASGR2/H2b cytoplasmic domain recovered an Hsp/immunophilin heterocomplex from HuH-7 cytosol, with Hsp90 verified by immunoblot. Native ASGPR immunoadsorption also recovered Hsp90, and rapamycin or the Trf1 trafficking defect reduced Hsp90 association while decreasing surface receptor without changing total receptor.

source.title: Evidence that peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha is complexed with the 90-kDa heat shock protein and the hepatitis virus B X-associated protein 2.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Mouse liver cytosol and mammalian two-hybrid assays.
evidence_limitations: The source does not distinguish HSP90AA1 from HSP90AB1 and does not establish folding, stability, or degradation dependence.
claim_summary: PPARA co-immunoprecipitates with Hsp90 and XAP2, and mammalian two-hybrid/domain assays map Hsp90 association to the PPARA E/F region.

source.title: Molecular chaperones Hsp90 and Hsp70 deliver preproteins to the mitochondrial import receptor Tom70.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Recombinant human TOMM70A cytosolic domains, purified bovine Hsp90/Hsp70, rabbit reticulocyte lysate, isolated rat liver mitochondria, COS-7 cells, and parallel Saccharomyces cerevisiae Tom70/Hsp82/Ssa experiments.
evidence_limitations: Mammalian Hsp90 is not alpha/beta resolved, and functional assays combine cross-species reagents. Geldanamycin supports Hsp90 dependence but is not isoform-selective; the chaperone-client biology concerns imported preproteins, not TOMM70A.
claim_summary: Human Tom70 directly captures Hsp90 from rabbit reticulocyte lysate and purified bovine Hsp90 through its N-terminal TPR clamp; the R192A clamp mutant abolishes binding. C-terminal Hsp90 competition, geldanamycin, and clamp mutants impair import of selected Tom70-dependent mitochondrial preproteins, supporting Tom70 as a membrane-localized Hsp90/Hsp70 cochaperone.

source.title: Regulation of telomerase activity and anti-apoptotic function by protein-protein interaction and phosphorylation.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human umbilical vein endothelial cells expressing myc-tagged human TERT and human 293 cells; novobiocin, geldanamycin, LY294002, Akt phosphorylation mutants, PP2A constructs, and okadaic acid were used.
evidence_limitations: The HSP90 antibody and manuscript wording are isoform-unspecified, the immunoblot is labeled generically as Akt, and novobiocin-dependent signaling does not establish binary HSP90-AKT1 binding or AKT1 folding/stability dependence.
claim_summary: Endogenous Akt immunoreactivity was recovered in broad HSP90 immunoprecipitates from HUVEC expressing myc-TERT, and novobiocin disrupted the HSP90-Akt-TERT complex and Akt phosphorylation; phosphomimetic Akt restored telomerase activity and reduced apoptosis.

source.title: Regulation of telomerase activity and anti-apoptotic function by protein-protein interaction and phosphorylation.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human umbilical vein endothelial cells expressing myc-tagged human TERT and human 293 cells; novobiocin, geldanamycin, LY294002, Akt phosphorylation mutants, PP2A constructs, and okadaic acid were used.
evidence_limitations: The HSP90 reagent is isoform-unspecified, TERT was overexpressed for co-IP, novobiocin is not isoform-selective, and geldanamycin did not reduce telomerase activity or disrupt the complex in this study. The functional rescue supports an Akt-mediated pathway rather than TERT client dependence.
claim_summary: Myc-tagged human TERT was recovered in broad HSP90 immunoprecipitates from HUVEC, and novobiocin disrupted HSP90-TERT-Akt complex recovery while reducing telomerase activity; active Akt and PP2A-directed experiments placed much of the functional effect through Akt phosphorylation.

source.title: Tyrosine phosphorylation of HSP90 within the P2X7 receptor complex negatively regulates P2X7 receptors.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AB1/Hsp90beta; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: HEK cells and native macrophage P2X7 receptor complexes.
evidence_limitations: The authors report no receptor trafficking or degradation effect and do not establish client biology.
claim_summary: HSP90 in the P2X7 receptor complex is tyrosine phosphorylated; geldanamycin changes phosphorylation and receptor activity, while the exact beta identity comes from the separately reviewed complex-proteomics paper.

source.title: G protein-coupled receptor kinase interaction with Hsp90 mediates kinase maturation.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Endogenous GRK2 in human HL60 cells for co-IP, dose/time, pulse-chase, and protease-inhibitor studies; transient human GRK2 and other GRKs in monkey COS-1 cells for replication and family comparison.
evidence_limitations: Functional dependence is established only with geldanamycin and is not genetically rescued. The pan-Hsp90 co-IP band is isoform-unresolved and may represent a modified or alternative variant, so client biology cannot be assigned specifically to HSP90AB1.
claim_summary: Pan-Hsp90 co-immunoprecipitates with endogenous GRK2, and geldanamycin disrupts the complex, lowers GRK2 abundance, accelerates loss of newly synthesized GRK2, and increases insoluble and proteasome-sensitive GRK2. Purified Hsp90 does not alter mature GRK2 kinase activity, supporting a folding/maturation interpretation rather than acute catalytic regulation.

source.title: G protein-coupled receptor kinase interaction with Hsp90 mediates kinase maturation.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AB1/Hsp90beta; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Endogenous human GRK2 immunoprecipitated from HL60 promyelocytic leukemia cells; anti-GRK4-6 immunoprecipitation served as the comparator.
evidence_limitations: The exact HSP90AB1 assignment comes from the discovery band only. The subsequent pan-Hsp90 co-IP band ran slightly larger and was not detected by alpha- or beta-specific antibodies, so those orthogonal experiments cannot be used to confirm beta identity.
claim_summary: Mass spectrometry of an endogenous GRK2/ADRBK1 immunoprecipitate from HL60 cells identifies Hsp90beta with 19 matching peptides and 31% sequence coverage. This exact-beta physical result is separated from the later pan-Hsp90 immunoblot and geldanamycin experiments.

source.title: A physical and functional map of the human TNF-alpha/NF-kappa B signal transduction pathway.

isoform_scope_note: Both cytosolic isoforms are compared; the scope alone does not establish an isoform-exclusive relationship.
model_context: Human HEK293 TNF/NF-kappaB affinity-purification interaction map.
evidence_limitations: Co-purification supports shared complex membership, not binary binding, client status, or isoform preference.
claim_summary: The primary interaction-map supplements contain exact IKKbeta-HSP90alpha and IKKbeta-HSP90beta co-purification edges; a separate locally reviewed paper validates the endogenous Hsp90-CDC37-IKK complex.

source.title: Hsp90/p50cdc37 is required for mixed-lineage kinase (MLK) 3 signaling.

isoform_scope_note: Both cytosolic isoforms are mentioned without a necessarily resolved comparison; no specificity is inferred.
model_context: Mammalian MLK3 kinase-chaperone complexes.
evidence_limitations: This row describes CDC37's cycle role and does not make CDC37 a client.
claim_summary: CDC37 co-purifies and co-immunoprecipitates with MLK3 and both cytosolic Hsp90 isoforms as part of the kinase chaperone machinery.

source.title: Hsp90/p50cdc37 is required for mixed-lineage kinase (MLK) 3 signaling.

isoform_scope_note: Both cytosolic isoforms are mentioned without a necessarily resolved comparison; no specificity is inferred.
model_context: Mammalian cells expressing FLAG-MLK3 with endogenous validation.
evidence_limitations: The inhibitor is pan-Hsp90 and the study does not test isoform-specific dependence.
claim_summary: MLK3 complexes contain Hsp90alpha, Hsp90beta, and CDC37; geldanamycin reduces MLK3 abundance and signaling, supporting Hsp90-dependent kinase stability.

source.title: Comprehensive proteomic analysis of interphase and mitotic 14-3-3-binding proteins.

isoform_scope_note: Both cytosolic isoforms are compared; the scope alone does not establish an isoform-exclusive relationship.
model_context: Human HeLa interphase and nocodazole-synchronized mitotic lysates applied to bacterially produced GST-14-3-3zeta or GST control columns; bound proteins were high-salt washed, R18/11-eluted, and identified by LC-MS/MS with manual spectrum validation.
evidence_limitations: The authors explicitly state that the affinity pool can include proteins bound indirectly through another 14-3-3 interactor. HSP90alpha/beta were not individually validated by pull-down, far-Western, or co-IP, and the assay provides no HSP90 client evidence or isoform preference.
claim_summary: GST-14-3-3zeta affinity chromatography with high-salt washes and R18/11 peptide elution recovered isoform-resolved HSP90 proteins from HeLa lysate: HSP90alpha had five unique peptides in mitotic and six in interphase material, while HSP90beta had 29 and 25 unique peptides across mitotic gel pools.

source.title: Regulation of vascular endothelial growth factor receptor 2-mediated phosphorylation of focal adhesion kinase by heat shock protein 90 and Src kinase activities.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Primary human umbilical vein endothelial cells for endogenous association and signaling; porcine aortic endothelial cells lacking endogenous VEGFR2 transfected with human wild-type or delta130 VEGFR2 for migration tests.
evidence_limitations: The Hsp90 antibody and wording are not isoform-specific, direct binding is explicitly unresolved, and no KDR folding, abundance, or degradation endpoint is tested. Geldanamycin and a 130-residue deletion cannot isolate a canonical client mechanism.
claim_summary: VEGF stimulation increases Hsp90 recovered with endogenous KDR/VEGFR2 in HUVECs, while geldanamycin suppresses this association. An HA-tagged VEGFR2 mutant lacking the last 130 residues fails to recover Hsp90 yet retains p38 signaling, and the same deletion blocks the Hsp90-RhoA-ROCK-FAK Tyr407 pathway and VEGF-directed endothelial migration.

source.title: Inhibition of heat shock protein 90, a novel RET/PTC1-associated protein, increases radioiodide accumulation in thyroid cells.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Transient human RET/PTC1 or RET/PTC3 in human 293FT and ARO thyroid cancer cells; doxycycline-inducible or constitutive RET/PTC1 in rat PC-Cl3 thyroid cells; additional rat FRTL-5, human ARO/TPC1, COS-7, and HeLa-NIS comparisons.
evidence_limitations: The tested protein is the oncogenic RET/PTC1 fusion, not wild-type full-length RET. Hsp90 is not alpha/beta resolved, client dependence rests on 17-AAG without genetic rescue, and increased radioiodide accumulation also occurs in parental cells and is not a RET-specific endpoint.
claim_summary: FLAG immunoprecipitation followed by MALDI-TOF and Western blot identifies generic Hsp90 and p50cdc37 with oncogenic RET/PTC1 in 293FT and ARO thyroid cancer cells; kinase-domain tyrosine mutants retain association. 17-AAG rapidly lowers inducible and constitutive RET/PTC1 protein, consistent with broad-Hsp90 dependence of the fusion oncoprotein.

source.title: Cytoplasmic localization of pregnane X receptor and ligand-dependent nuclear translocation in mouse liver.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Mouse PXR-V5 and CCRP-V5 expressed in human HepG2 cells; endogenous Hsp90 co-IP; mouse liver PXR localization and PXR-CCRP FRET; CCRP siRNA and PXR reporter assays.
evidence_limitations: Anti-Hsp90 clone MA3-011 does not distinguish HSP90AA1 from HSP90AB1. The paper does not perturb Hsp90 or establish direct PXR-Hsp90 binding, stability, or maturation; liver FRET tests PXR-CCRP rather than PXR-Hsp90.
claim_summary: Mouse PXR and CCRP co-occur with endogenous cytosolic Hsp90 in anti-Hsp90 immunoprecipitates, while CCRP abundance and depletion alter PXR localization and reporter output. The Hsp90 reagent is broad and the functional experiments primarily test the PXR-CCRP axis.

source.title: Characterization of a Novel Interaction between the Secretory Na+-K+-Cl- Cotransporter and the Chaperone hsp90

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AA1/Hsp90alpha; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Yeast two-hybrid used human Hsp90alpha residues 1-243/245 and NKCC1 C-terminal fragments; reciprocal co-IP used endogenous human Hsp90alpha and overexpressed shark NKCC1 in human HEK293 cells.
evidence_limitations: The binding evidence is exact for Hsp90alpha, but no Hsp90beta comparator was tested. The transport response to geldanamycin was complex and may include downstream or off-target effects, so it is not client evidence.
claim_summary: Human Hsp90alpha N-terminal constructs bound NKCC1 C-terminal constructs in yeast two-hybrid assays, and endogenous human Hsp90alpha reciprocally coimmunoprecipitated with overexpressed shark NKCC1 in HEK293 cells. Geldanamycin altered NKCC1 transport but did not establish Hsp90alpha-specific client dependence.

source.title: Mammalian CHORD-containing protein 1 is a novel heat shock protein 90-interacting protein

isoform_scope_note: Both cytosolic isoforms are compared; the scope alone does not establish an isoform-exclusive relationship.
model_context: Mouse Chp-1 constructs were expressed in human HEK293 cells; endogenous co-IP used human PC3 cells; yeast two-hybrid used full-length and truncated human Hsp90beta plus Hsp90alpha; purified-Hsp90 source/isoform was not specified.
evidence_limitations: The paper supports direct interaction with both alpha and beta but does not establish isoform preference or client biology. Its proposed cochaperone interpretation is based substantially on homology rather than demonstrated Hsp90-cycle function.
claim_summary: CHORDC1/Chp-1 complexes contained both Hsp90alpha and Hsp90beta by mass spectrometry, endogenous proteins coimmunoprecipitated, purified Hsp90 bound GST-Chp-1, and yeast two-hybrid experiments explicitly detected Chp-1 binding to both cytosolic Hsp90 isoforms, including mapped Hsp90beta constructs.

source.title: A central role for the Hsp90.Cdc37 molecular chaperone module in interleukin-1 receptor-associated-kinase-dependent signaling by toll-like receptors.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: FLAG-IRAK1 studies used human 293T cells; endogenous complex and signaling experiments used primary mouse bone-marrow-derived macrophages.
evidence_limitations: All Hsp90 reagents and claims are pan-cytosolic or isoform-unspecified. Client dependence is supported by two inhibitor chemotypes plus physical complexes, but no isoform-selective genetic perturbation was performed.
claim_summary: IRAK1, but not the IRAK4 comparator, associated with an Hsp90-Cdc37 complex in affinity purification and co-IP experiments. Geldanamycin and radicicol shortened IRAK1 half-life, reduced IRAK1 abundance and activity, and impaired downstream Toll-like receptor signaling, supporting cytosolic-Hsp90-dependent client behavior without resolving alpha versus beta.

source.title: Hsp90-Akt phosphorylates ASK1 and inhibits ASK1-mediated apoptosis

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AB1/Hsp90beta; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Co-IP and signaling studies used bovine aortic endothelial cells; Akt-null and matched mouse embryonic fibroblasts tested pathway dependence; human Flag-Hsp90beta constructs and ASK1 Ser83Ala mutants were used.
evidence_limitations: The beta construct gives exact route support, but no purified binary binding or alpha/beta comparison was performed. Much of the functional evidence used broad Hsp90 perturbation or overexpression and supports regulation through Akt, not MAP3K5 folding dependence.
claim_summary: Endogenous Hsp90, Akt, and ASK1/MAP3K5 coimmunoprecipitated, and full-length or middle-domain Flag-Hsp90beta constructs associated with endogenous ASK1 and Akt. Hsp90 overexpression suppressed ASK1 signaling through Akt-dependent ASK1 Ser83 phosphorylation, supporting an Hsp90beta-containing regulatory complex rather than ASK1 client biology.

source.title: Rational design of shepherdin, a novel anticancer agent

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Biochemical assays used recombinant survivin, rabbit reticulocyte lysate, synthetic shepherdin, and recombinant Hsp90 domains; cellular work included human PC3 and other tumor models.
evidence_limitations: The manuscript uses generic Hsp90 wording, and the tested C-terminal construct length does not justify assigning alpha. Survivin loss follows a designed Hsp90-binding peptide intervention rather than isoform-selective Hsp90 perturbation. Supplemental molecular-dynamics methods and Table S1 were not locally available.
claim_summary: Recombinant survivin/BIRC5 associated with endogenous Hsp90 in rabbit reticulocyte lysate, while a survivin-derived peptide bound the Hsp90 N-terminal pocket in surface-plasmon-resonance and affinity experiments. Shepherdin disrupted the complex and reduced survivin abundance, but the Hsp90 isoform and the specificity of peptide-mediated client effects were unresolved.

source.title: Inhibition of histone deacetylase 6 acetylates and disrupts the chaperone function of heat shock protein 90: a novel basis for antileukemia activity of histone deacetylase inhibitors.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Mechanistic experiments used human K562 leukemia cells with HDAC6 overexpression or siRNA; additional drug-response work included MV4-11 and HL-60 cells.
evidence_limitations: Antibodies and manuscript wording do not resolve HSP90AA1 from HSP90AB1. Genetic HDAC6 perturbation strengthens the regulatory claim, but the relationship is regulation of Hsp90 acetylation and function, not HDAC6 client biology.
claim_summary: HDAC6 coimmunoprecipitated with Hsp90. HDAC6 overexpression reduced inhibitor-induced Hsp90 acetylation, whereas HDAC6 knockdown increased Hsp90 acetylation, reduced ATP binding, disrupted Bcr-Abl association, and promoted client loss, supporting HDAC6 as an upstream regulator of cytosolic Hsp90 function without isoform resolution.

source.title: Chaperoning checkpoint kinase 1 (Chk1), an Hsp90 client, with purified chaperones.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human full-length Chk1 and Chk1 kinase-domain constructs studied in HeLa cells, rabbit reticulocyte lysate, bacteria-derived substrate preparations, and a reconstituted chaperone system using Sf9-expressed Hsp90/Hsp70 plus Ydj1, Cdc37, CK2, and Hop.
evidence_limitations: The paper names the purified component only as Hsp90 and does not identify alpha or beta in its own Methods. The purified activation assay uses a multi-chaperone mixture and a truncated Chk1 domain. Endogenous Chk1 is not detectably recovered in the displayed HeLa Hsp90 immunoprecipitation in Figure 1, so the database's in-vivo association label is not independently supported by that panel.
claim_summary: Human Chk1 loses kinase activity after 17-AAG exposure in rabbit reticulocyte lysate, and a purified Hsp90/Hsp70/Cdc37/Ydj1/CK2 chaperone system strongly activates the Chk1 kinase domain. Hsp90 is recovered with active domain protein, while full-length Chk1 binds Hsp90 transiently during reactivation. These results support broad cytosolic-Hsp90 client biology for CHEK1.

source.title: Conformational diversity in the TPR domain-mediated interaction of protein phosphatase 5 with Hsp90

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Purified human PPP5C TPR residues 19-147, including wild type and G83N mutant, were studied with an acetylated synthetic Hsp90 MEEVD pentapeptide by solution NMR and biochemical binding measurements.
evidence_limitations: The experiment uses a shared terminal pentapeptide rather than full-length, isoform-identified Hsp90. It establishes a direct canonical TPR-cochaperone interaction but neither beta exclusivity nor client biology.
claim_summary: NMR and binding analyses defined how the human PPP5C TPR domain recognizes the conserved Hsp90 C-terminal MEEVD peptide through the two-carboxylate clamp and conformational rearrangement. This is direct cochaperone-motif evidence, but MEEVD is shared by HSP90AA1 and HSP90AB1 and therefore cannot support the beta-specific route.

source.title: Hsp90 recognizes a common surface on client kinases.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human DAPK2/Drp1 constructs in HEK293T association context and COS7 17-AAG degradation assays; the supplement provides the displayed DAPK2 time course.
evidence_limitations: The Hsp90 antibody is not isoform-resolved, the DAPK2 association is stated but not displayed, and the only displayed DAPK2 functional evidence is pan-Hsp90 inhibitor response. The main text swaps the DAPK2 and DAPK3 aliases, whereas the supplement uses the accepted DAPK2/Drp1 mapping.
claim_summary: The Results state that DAPK-family kinases associate with Hsp90, although DAPK2 association data are not shown, and the supplement shows time-dependent DAPK2/Drp1 loss after 17-AAG. This supports broad Hsp90-dependent candidate-client behavior, not beta-resolved client biology.

source.title: Hsp90 recognizes a common surface on client kinases.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human DAPK3/Zipk constructs in HEK293T association context and COS7 17-AAG degradation assays; the supplement provides the displayed DAPK3 time course.
evidence_limitations: The Hsp90 antibody is not isoform-resolved, the DAPK3 association is stated but not displayed, and the only displayed DAPK3 functional evidence is pan-Hsp90 inhibitor response. The main text swaps the DAPK2 and DAPK3 aliases, whereas the supplement uses the accepted DAPK3/Zipk mapping.
claim_summary: The Results state that DAPK-family kinases associate with Hsp90, although DAPK3 association data are not shown, and the supplement shows time-dependent DAPK3/Zipk loss after 17-AAG. This supports broad Hsp90-dependent candidate-client behavior, not beta-resolved client biology.

source.title: Interaction of pro-apoptotic protein HGTD-P with heat shock protein 90 is required for induction of mitochondrial apoptotic cascades.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human A549 cells overexpressing HGTD-P/FAM162A; geldanamycin, radicicol, herbimycin A, lactacystin, apoptosis, localization, and turnover assays.
evidence_limitations: The only exact cytosolic-Hsp90 clone in the paper is HSP90AB1, not HSP90AA1. Alpha support is therefore same-gene unresolved. Functional dependence is inferred from multiple Hsp90 inhibitors without isoform-selective or genetic Hsp90 perturbation.
claim_summary: Broad endogenous Hsp90 co-immunoprecipitates with overexpressed FAM162A, and Hsp90 inhibitors reduce FAM162A-associated apoptosis, alter its mitochondrial localization, and promote its proteasome-sensitive loss. These functional data are pan-Hsp90 and inhibitor-dependent, so they do not resolve the alpha route.

source.title: Interaction of pro-apoptotic protein HGTD-P with heat shock protein 90 is required for induction of mitochondrial apoptotic cascades.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AB1/Hsp90beta; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Human HGTD-P/FAM162A bait in a human brain yeast two-hybrid library; human A549 cells expressing HA-HGTD-P for co-IP.
evidence_limitations: Exact beta resolution comes from the yeast two-hybrid clone identity, while the mammalian co-IP antibody is pan-Hsp90. The source does not compare HSP90AA1, and yeast two-hybrid plus co-IP do not establish an Hsp90 chaperone-client relationship.
claim_summary: A human brain-library yeast two-hybrid screen recovered three Hsp90beta clones against HGTD-P/FAM162A, and overexpressed FAM162A co-immunoprecipitated with endogenous broad Hsp90 in A549 cells. The clone accession M16660 resolves the screen hit to HSP90AB1.

source.title: Geldanamycins trigger a novel Ron degradative pathway, hampering oncogenic signaling.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Experiments used murine NIH3T3 cells expressing wild-type or M1254T Ron, human FG2 pancreatic carcinoma cells with endogenous Ron, and monkey COS-7 cells for CHIP and ubiquitination assays.
evidence_limitations: The Hsp90 reagents and language are isoform-unspecified. Client dependence is pharmacologically initiated, although physical complexes, CHIP knockdown, and in vitro ubiquitination strengthen the mechanism. Supplemental Figures 1-3 were not locally available.
claim_summary: Wild-type and oncogenic M1254T Ron/MST1R associated with Hsp90-Hsc70-CHIP complexes. Geldanamycin and 17-AAG promoted Ron degradation, and CHIP knockdown or ligase assays supported a chaperone-coupled degradation mechanism, establishing cytosolic-Hsp90 client behavior without alpha/beta resolution.

source.title: The platelet-derived growth factor receptor alpha is destabilized by geldanamycins in cancer cells.

isoform_scope_note: Both cytosolic isoforms are compared; the scope alone does not establish an isoform-exclusive relationship.
model_context: Human tumor lines including Ty5, C272, C848, U118, and SH-SY5Y; COS and NIH3T3 overexpression controls; transformed-versus-untransformed comparisons.
evidence_limitations: Co-immunoprecipitation used broad Hsp90 detection, the pharmacology was not isoform-selective, and the strongest dependency was in transformed cells; the siRNA experiment nevertheless compared alpha and beta directly.
claim_summary: PDGFRA associates with cytosolic Hsp90 and CDC37 in cancer-cell contexts; separate HSP90alpha and HSP90beta siRNAs reduce PDGFRA, and Hsp90 inhibition promotes receptor ubiquitination, proteasome-dependent loss, altered localization/conformation, and reduced growth.

source.title: Hsp90 cochaperone Aha1 downregulation rescues misfolding of CFTR in cystic fibrosis.

isoform_scope_note: Both cytosolic isoforms are mentioned without a necessarily resolved comparison; no specificity is inferred.
model_context: BHK cells expressing human wild-type or DeltaF508 CFTR, HEK293 cells, CFBE41o- bronchial epithelial cells, and primary/corrected human bronchial epithelial comparisons.
evidence_limitations: The exact beta pair has proteomic co-complex support, but functional dependence is inferred through Aha1 perturbation and broad Hsp90 association rather than HSP90AB1-selective perturbation; BHK host-chaperone accession/species mapping also warrants caution.
claim_summary: CFTR affinity purifications identify both Hsp90beta and Hsp90alpha, with Hsp90beta explicitly listed in Table 1; Aha1 knockdown alters CFTR-Hsp90 association and improves DeltaF508 CFTR maturation, surface delivery, and channel function.

source.title: A chaperone-dependent GSK3beta transitional intermediate mediates activation-loop autophosphorylation.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Rabbit reticulocyte lysate expressing HA-tagged human GSK3beta, supplemented with purified recombinant human Hsp90; mature-kinase controls distinguish folding from steady-state catalysis.
evidence_limitations: The manuscript calls the reagent human Hsp90 without an alpha/beta designation or catalog detail, and the missing Figure S1 contains additional specificity controls; the paper does not establish HSP90AB1-selective dependence.
claim_summary: GSK3beta enters a transient Hsp90-associated folding state required for Tyr216 autophosphorylation; broad Hsp90 inhibitors block that step, Hsp90 co-immunoprecipitates with the autophosphorylation-competent state, and purified recombinant human Hsp90 restores autophosphorylation in a depleted reticulocyte-lysate system.

source.title: Hsp90 regulates the Fanconi anemia DNA damage response pathway.

isoform_scope_note: Both cytosolic isoforms are mentioned without a necessarily resolved comparison; no specificity is inferred.
model_context: Flag-HA FANCA complexes purified from human HeLa cells, with reciprocal overexpression co-IP and endogenous FANCA/Hsp90/p23 co-IP in HeLa and K562 cells; isoform-specific Hsp90alpha and Hsp90beta antibodies are listed in Methods.
evidence_limitations: The isoform-specific confirmation is stated but not displayed. AP-MS and co-IP establish association or complex membership, not direct binding or isoform-specific chaperone dependence.
claim_summary: Hsp90alpha and Hsp90beta were identified among major proteins in affinity-purified FANCA complexes, and the Results state that FANCA association with both isoforms was confirmed using isoform-specific antibodies. Displayed reciprocal and endogenous co-immunoprecipitations establish broad Hsp90 complex membership; the exact alpha/beta confirmation is reported as data not shown.

source.title: Hsp90 regulates the Fanconi anemia DNA damage response pathway.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Human HeLa, MCF7, K562, Jurkat, RPMI8226, and Fanconi-anemia fibroblast or lymphoblast models; mouse NIH3T3 cells; rabbit reticulocyte lysate; mitomycin C and Hsp90-inhibitor perturbations.
evidence_limitations: The functional experiments do not compare Hsp90alpha with Hsp90beta. Hsp90 siRNA produced only mild depletion and no FANCA effect in a result reported as data not shown, so client dependence is driven mainly by several pan-Hsp90 inhibitors plus turnover and pathway readouts. The in-vitro association uses reticulocyte lysate rather than purified binary proteins.
claim_summary: Multiple Hsp90 inhibitors accelerate proteasome-dependent FANCA turnover, increase FANCA ubiquitination and CHIP association, redistribute FANCA to the cytoplasm, and impair FANCD2 monoubiquitination, repair foci, chromosome stability, and survival after DNA cross-linking. This supports FANCA client biology at broad cytosolic-Hsp90 scope.

source.title: Hsp90 is required to localise cyclin B and Msps/ch-TOG to the mitotic spindle in Drosophila and humans.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Drosophila embryo and neuroblast Hsp83 systems plus human HeLa cells; CCNB1 is represented through the Cyclin B orthology bridge.
evidence_limitations: Direct association is demonstrated in Drosophila, whereas the human result is inhibitor-based localization; protein abundance is unchanged and neither human Hsp90 isoform is resolved.
claim_summary: Drosophila Cyclin B affinity purification identifies Hsp83 and Msps, endogenous complexes are recovered reciprocally, and Hsp83 mutation or geldanamycin alters Cyclin B spindle localization; human HeLa cells show a parallel cyclin B localization phenotype after Hsp90 inhibition without loss of total cyclin B.

source.title: Hsp90 is required to localise cyclin B and Msps/ch-TOG to the mitotic spindle in Drosophila and humans.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.
model_context: Drosophila embryo and neuroblast Hsp83 systems plus human HeLa cells; CKAP5 is represented through Msps/ch-TOG orthology.
evidence_limitations: The association is a multiprotein Drosophila complex and the human evidence is inhibitor-based localization; no purified binary interaction, turnover phenotype, or human isoform resolution is shown.
claim_summary: Msps is recovered with Drosophila Cyclin B and Hsp83, and Hsp83 mutation or geldanamycin disrupts Msps spindle localization; human ch-TOG/CKAP5 similarly loses normal spindle localization after Hsp90 inhibition without a reduction in total protein.

source.title: Heat shock protein 90alpha recruits FLIPS to the death-inducing signaling complex and contributes to TRAIL resistance in human glioma.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AA1/Hsp90alpha; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Human transformed astrocytes and glioma models, with FLIP_S as the primary CFLAR splice isoform and FLIP_L also recovered in HSP90alpha complexes.
evidence_limitations: The study demonstrates alpha-selective association and functional recruitment but not purified binary binding, stability dependence, or a rescue experiment; the claim is splice-isoform and tumor-context specific.

claim_summary: FLAG-XAP2/AIP co-immunoprecipitated endogenous Hsp90 in HEK cells. A TPR mutant lost Hsp90 recovery and most GR-inhibitory activity, while FKBP52 competed Hsp90 away from AIP and rescued GR transcription, supporting AIP as a broad Hsp90-binding cochaperone/regulator.

source.title: The molecular chaperone Hsp90 regulates accumulation of DNA polymerase eta at replication stalling sites in UV-irradiated cells.

isoform_scope_note: Both cytosolic isoforms are compared; the scope alone does not establish an isoform-exclusive relationship.
model_context: Human XP30RO fibroblasts and other cultured human cells examined after UV irradiation, 17-AAG treatment, cycloheximide chase, proteasome inhibition, and reported isoform-directed RNAi.
evidence_limitations: Both cytosolic isoforms associate with Pol eta, and most functional perturbation uses pan-Hsp90 inhibition. The locally archived PDF does not contain supplemental Figure S3D, so the reported RNAi result could not be visually audited. Alpha exclusivity is not established.
claim_summary: GFP-Pol eta co-immunoprecipitated separately detected Hsp90alpha and Hsp90beta, while reciprocal endogenous co-IP supported an Hsp90-Pol eta complex. Hsp90 inhibition reduced Pol eta abundance, shortened its half-life, promoted proteasome-sensitive loss, impaired UV-induced nuclear-focus accumulation, and reduced interaction with ubiquitinated PCNA; the text also reports alpha/beta RNAi effects in supplemental Figure S3D.

source.title: A quantitative chaperone interaction network reveals the architecture of cellular protein homeostasis pathways.

isoform_scope_note: Both cytosolic isoforms are compared; the scope alone does not establish an isoform-exclusive relationship.
model_context: Human chaperone interaction network; CDC37L1/Harc bait in AP-MS and quantitative LUMIER assays.
evidence_limitations: The assays support association with both cytosolic isoforms but do not establish purified binary binding, client dependence, or beta exclusivity.
claim_summary: Taipale 2014 reports CDC37L1-HSP90AB1 and CDC37L1-HSP90AA1 in the AP-MS/AvgP tables, with strong HSP90AB1 and HSP90AA1 LUMIER signals; this supports an alpha/beta-compared complex-association call without client biology or isoform exclusivity.

source.title: Localization of MRP-1 to the outer mitochondrial membrane by the chaperone protein HSP90β.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AB1/Hsp90beta; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Six human Ewing sarcoma cell lines, with mitochondrial fractionation, immunofluorescence, HSP90 isoform knockdown, and 17-AAG or NVP-AUY922 treatment.
evidence_limitations: The interaction IP uses a pan-alpha/beta HSP90 antibody, so the exact beta assignment rests on selective knockdown and localization evidence rather than beta-specific co-IP. Residual knockdown expression remained, and purified binary binding was not tested.
claim_summary: MRP1 co-immunoprecipitated with HSP90 using an antibody documented to recognize both alpha and beta. Isoform-directed knockdown then isolated the functional route: HSP90beta depletion, but not HSP90alpha depletion, reduced mitochondrial MRP1 without lowering total MRP1, and beta colocalization plus pan-Hsp90 inhibitor experiments supported HSP90beta-dependent outer-mitochondrial-membrane localization.

source.title: Hsp90α regulates ATM and NBN functions in sensing and repair of DNA double-strand breaks.

isoform_scope_note: The source does not resolve cytosolic Hsp90alpha from Hsp90beta; no isoform specificity is inferred.

evidence_limitations: Both compounds inhibit cytosolic Hsp90 rather than selectively isolating alpha. The anti-ubiquitin blot shows a total ubiquitin smear rather than an NBN immunoprecipitation followed by ubiquitin detection, so NBN-specific polyubiquitination is not demonstrated.
claim_summary: 17-AAG and radicicol reduced NBN abundance, and proteasome inhibition partially protected NBN from 17-AAG-associated loss. These data support Hsp90-dependent NBN stability but do not isolate HSP90AA1 from HSP90AB1.

source.title: Hsp90α regulates ATM and NBN functions in sensing and repair of DNA double-strand breaks.

claim_summary: An Hsp90alpha-labeled immunoprecipitation recovered NBN, and reciprocal NBN immunoprecipitation recovered Hsp90alpha. Irradiation altered complex recovery, supporting a stress-regulated Hsp90alpha-NBN complex.

source.title: Mutant p53 Drives Cancer Metastasis via RCP-Mediated Hsp90α Secretion.

claim_summary: Anti-Hsp90alpha affinity purification-mass spectrometry identified RAB11FIP1/RCP with multiple peptides in p53-null and mutant-p53 cells. Reciprocal co-IP, RCP domain mapping, and lysate-based recombinant Hsp90alpha/RCP pulldowns supported an exact alpha-RCP complex.

source.title: Mutant p53 Drives Cancer Metastasis via RCP-Mediated Hsp90α Secretion.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AA1/Hsp90alpha; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.

claim_summary: RAB11FIP1/RCP depletion disrupted Hsp90alpha association with Rab11A, reduced Hsp90alpha-CD63 colocalization and extracellular Hsp90alpha, and impaired migration and invasion; RCP overexpression increased Hsp90alpha secretion, while recombinant extracellular Hsp90alpha rescued migration and invasion after RCP depletion.

source.title: Dietary monounsaturated fatty acid facilitates lipid droplet turnover through chaperone HSP90A-mediated lysosomal degradation of PLIN2 in hepatocellular carcinoma.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AA1/Hsp90alpha; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.

claim_summary: Lipid-droplet proteomics identified HSP90A, explicitly defined as the HSP90AA1 product. HSP90A and PLIN2 reciprocally co-immunoprecipitated, oleic acid increased their lipid-droplet association, and HSP90A knockdown stabilized PLIN2 without changing its transcript; lysosomal inhibition and LAMP2A experiments placed HSP90A in PLIN2 lysosomal degradation.

source.title: Ribonuclease kappa promotes longevity by preventing age-associated accumulation of circular RNA in stress granules.

claim_summary: C. elegans RNK-1 IP-MS recovered HSP-90, hsp-90 RNAi increased two circRNAs, and human HSP90 knockdown increased a circPOLR2A reporter. HA-RNASEK coimmunoprecipitated cellular HSP90, with more association after arsenite or heat stress, and purified recombinant human Hsp90alpha coimmunoprecipitated with purified RNASEK-HA in vitro.

source.title: A human protein-protein interaction network: a resource for annotating the proteome.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AB1/Hsp90beta; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.

claim_summary: The complete interaction supplement records DDX24 as bait and HSPCB/HSP90AB1 as prey in yeast two-hybrid Table S3, PPI row 1948, with assay code SD4 and Qcount 1. This is an exact beta-resolved binary-screen observation.

source.title: Mitochondria-transliterated ALDH1L1 functions as a feedback regulator of redox homeostasis in cancer cells to enhance the resistance to pro-oxidative therapy.

source.title: Folding of Toll-like receptors by the HSP90 paralogue gp96 requires a substrate-specific cochaperone.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90B1/GRP94; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Purified murine gp96-CNPY3 binding plus mouse macrophage, pre-B-cell, and primary-cell genetic/trafficking assays with transfected HEK293 validation.
evidence_limitations: Established within a TLR-selective ER folding system and not evidence that CNPY3 serves all GRP94 clients. Nucleotide sensitivity was measured by endpoint binding rather than dissociation kinetics; affinity, stoichiometry, structural interface, and exact cycle timing remain unresolved. Cellular co-IPs used DSP crosslinking. Supplementary Figure S3 shows no visible major effect on gp96 ATPase activity but is not an equivalence test.
claim_summary: CNPY3 directly and nucleotide-sensitively binds HSP90B1/GRP94 and is genetically required for GRP94 loading, maturation, and function of multiple Toll-like receptor clients, including TLR9. This establishes CNPY3 as a TLR-selective ER cochaperone/client-loading factor, not as a GRP94 client or a general ATPase activator.

source.title: Protein interaction landscapes revealed by advanced in vivo cross-linking-mass spectrometry.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90B1/GRP94; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Intact human 293 Rpn11-HTBH cells were cross-linked for 1 h at 37 degrees C with 5 mM Alkyne-A-DSBSO, followed by sequential denaturing extraction, peptide enrichment, LC-MS, and multistage-MS identification.
evidence_limitations: Two unique lysine crosslinks place CNPY2 K49 near HSP90B1 K455 and K458 in intact cells. Proteome-wide XL-MS establishes an assay-level interprotein contact but not purified binary binding, client dependence, cochaperone function, or HSP90B1 exclusivity.
claim_summary: Dataset S2A rows 4410 and 7150 identify CNPY2 K49-HSP90B1 K455 and K458 crosslinks; the unique linkages recur in Dataset S2C rows 2387 and 2720.

source.title: Interactome Mapping Provides a Network of Neurodegenerative Disease Proteins and Uncovers Widespread Protein Aggregation in Affected Brains.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AA1/Hsp90alpha; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: Human HSP90AA1 bait and ADAMTSL4 prey fusion constructs tested in L40cc budding yeast with HIS3, URA3, and lacZ reporters; four pooled screens were followed by pairwise backmating and retesting.
evidence_limitations: The heterologous reporter does not establish purified native-protein binding, an endogenous mammalian complex, physiological colocalization, HSP90-dependent folding, or client status. HSP90AB1 was also screened, but absence of this pair cannot establish alpha preference or exclusivity given limited Y2H sensitivity.
claim_summary: Table S1 identifies HSP90AA1 clone CCSB_8199 among the non-autoactivating DNA-binding baits. Table S2 records HSP90AA1 and ADAMTSL4 in the final NN1.0 network after pooled screening and pairwise backmating. The NN1.0ext occurrence is inherited from NN1.0, and ADAMTSL4 was not included in the mammalian DULIP validation subset. This is one exact binary Y2H association, not multiple studies.

source.title: Casein kinase 2-mediated phosphorylation of Hsp90beta regulates pregnane X receptor stability and function.

isoform_scope_note: The source resolves HSP90AB1/Hsp90beta; exclusivity relative to other isoforms is not inferred.
model_context: LS174T human colon adenocarcinoma cells; in-vitro-translated PXR GST pull-down; CK2/rifampin intervention context.
evidence_limitations: The GST assay uses translated PXR, not two purified proteins. The cellular HSP90beta antibody was not catalog- or cross-reactivity-verified, and no alpha binding countertest was reported. CK2 inhibition, pan-HSP90 inhibition and MG132 rescue do not isolate beta-dependent PXR turnover; Figure 5E cell model differs between prose and caption. PXR is the NR1I2 alias; the frozen HSP90AB1::PXR route key is retained only as provenance after canonical reconciliation. Local Figure 5 panel image/package is absent; primary full-text caption and Methods were checked online, so lane integrity and label completeness were not visually verified locally.
claim_summary: Rifampin increases NR1I2/PXR recovered with cellular HSP90beta, and CK2-treated GST-HSP90beta pulls down in-vitro-translated NR1I2/PXR. This supports a beta-scoped association/direct-partner assertion, not purified binary binding, beta exclusivity, or beta-specific client dependence.
